nodes.description: Public token name string, set once in the constructor.
Public token symbol string, set once in the constructor.
Public uint8 token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
Total token supply state variable set in constructor and read by totalSupply().
Core ledger mapping(address => uint) of token balances, mutated by constructor, transfer and transferFrom.
Core nested allowance mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)), written by approve and transferFrom.
Constructor that mints the whole supply to msg.sender and initializes metadata.
View function returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
View function returning balances[tokenOwner].
View function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Public function writing allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens without any allowance-race protection.
Public function debiting msg.sender and crediting the recipient using safeSub/safeAdd.
Public function moving tokens using the caller allowance; the allowance is spendable by any caller-supplied spender path without explicit approval check beyond safeSub revert.
Pure addition helper with overflow require(c >= a).
Pure subtraction helper with underflow require(b <= a).
Pure multiplication helper checking a == 0 || c / a == b.
Pure division helper requiring b > 0.
msg.sender used during construction as the initial token recipient.
msg.sender used as owner key when writing the allowance mapping.
msg.sender used as the debited account in transfer.
msg.sender used as spender key into the allowed mapping in transferFrom.
State write balances[msg.sender] = safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens) in transfer.
State write balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) in transfer.
State write allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens in approve; overwrites allowance unsafely.
State write balances[from] = safeSub(balances[from], tokens) in transferFrom.
State write allowed[from][msg.sender] = safeSub(allowed[from][msg.sender], tokens) in transferFrom.
Arithmetic c = a + b inside safeAdd (overflow guarded by require).
Arithmetic c = a - b inside safeSub (underflow guarded by require).
Arithmetic c = a * b inside safeMul (overflow guarded by division check).
Arithmetic c = a / b inside safeDiv (zero divisor guarded by require).
State write balances[msg.sender] = _totalSupply minting the entire supply in the constructor.

edges.reason: msg.sender is consumed by the constructor to seed metadata and mint supply.
msg.sender directly determines who receives the minted balances write in the constructor.
msg.sender flows into approve as the allowance owner key.
Caller-controlled msg.sender is used as the mapping key of the allowance write in approve.
msg.sender flows into transfer as the debited account.
Caller-controlled msg.sender is the account whose balance is rewritten in transfer.
msg.sender flows into transferFrom as the spender identity.
msg.sender indexes the allowance mapping that transferFrom debits.
transfer invokes safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer invokes safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom invokes safeSub for both the balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom invokes safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
safeSub return value is written back into balances[msg.sender] in transfer.
safeAdd return value is written into balances[to] in transfer.
transfer's sender-balance write mutates the balances mapping.
transfer's recipient-balance write mutates the balances mapping.
approve writes a new value into the allowed mapping.
transferFrom debits the from-account in the balances mapping.
transferFrom decrements the spender allowance in the allowed mapping.
Constructor mint writes the total supply into balances.
The addition operation defines the safeAdd return value.
The subtraction operation defines the safeSub return value.
The multiplication operation defines the safeMul return value.
The division operation defines the safeDiv return value.
Constructor initializes the balances mapping.
Constructor sets the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] from state.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the queried owner.
allowance reads the allowed mapping for the queried pair.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
balanceOf returns the value stored in local balance.
allowance returns the value stored in local remaining.
totalSupply derives its result from _totalSupply and the zero-address balance.
